summary: Magnolia Oil & Gas Corp filed an 8-K reporting its entry into a purchase agreement to acquire 100% of WildFire Intermediate Holdings (Target) from WildFire Energy I LLC. Consideration comprises $2.65 billion cash, 32,203,000 shares of Magnolia Class A common stock, and assumption of $600 million of Target's 7.500% Senior Notes due 2029. The board recommendation was not specified; no advisors were named. Closing is subject to HSR clearance and customary conditions. A $200 million escrow deposit secures performance. Watch for antitrust review timelines and financing risk-arb spread on the cash-and-stock mix.
